There is some thing about newness......freshness.....

Like being young and having your whole life ahead of you... Or founding a new country and being able to create its founding laws..

The steel of voat is just now being forged.. The irons still hot and malleable.. This is the point in time in which the ground-work is being lain for what will become the future of voat, for better or for worse..

As can be seen in almost any thing else, the longer some thing exists and the bigger it becomes, the more entrenched it becomes in its own status-quo, and the less pliable it becomes, and usually eventually breaks.. Some examples: ・Governments (get too big and move too slow, too many laws and nothing changes) ・People (old people get set in their ways and mentalities) ・digg ・reddit ・maybe 4chan?

At some point there comes a time when it is time to jump ship on to a newly-crafted ship; away from the old one that is riddled with duct-tape and holes.. You guys are just some of the first ones to do that, but the masses will surely follow when they catch wind of the changes that are happening with in their precious reddit community.. And really..at one time, reddit really was precious... But when some thing becomes that big, it also becomes harder to manage.. It would be wonderful if reddit could stay perfect for ever...and technically it is possible to fix all the problems with reddit...But do you think that is what is going to happen?.. Probably not.. It will most likely follow the same path that digg did..

Did you know that digg is still technically alive and you can still go visit there even today?.. Technically alive, but essentially dead.. Same for reddit; even though you SEE reddit and will always be able to VISIT reddit.com, that doesn't mean that it won't eventually become just a shell of its former glory..

Now I want to talk a little about the importance of sites like digg, reddit, and voat: Just as thoughts in a person's mind can eventually turn in to will and then in to action, sites that provide an unrestricted agora where any one can meet and exchange uncensored news, ideas, thoughts, and opinions is one of the major corner-stones in being able to affect change in today's world and society.. When places like that become corrupted and censored from truly free speech and free opinion, the possibility of making real change in our world is also stifled.. For example, some governments in our world can be very corrupt, secretive, and abrasive, and usually countries like this have their own one-sided opinion/propaganda playing 24 hours per day on all of their television stations.. But which kind of television channels do the normal people have to broad-cast their opinion up on?.. None.. Therefore, they must look to alternative places such as the internet to have any real discussion about real things going on in the world and their country.. But if the only sites that they find are heavily corrupted and censored, and have any dissident deleted, then really, that leaves no options for normal people to get potentially important information out to the world.. And with out that information, other people might not be able to form the most informed opinion about the current situation of their society and their country and world, which will also lead to them not being able to make the most informed decision about which actions to execute..

The internet has the POTENTIAL to allow free speech and communication.. Web-sites can be a manifestation of that potential.. The internet still needs web-sites to work.. If the web-sites are corrupt and become nothing but propaganda, then that potential is lost..

I have a lot of hope for voat, however, just like governments, it needs its own set of checks and balances.. Of course nothing can last for ever, and eventually voat will become obsolete too in the future, but it would be nice if we could prevent voat from becoming corrupted for as long as possible, so that we don't have to jump ship again for a long time..

Other thoughts in my brain: ・In general, I tend to favor things that are distributed/P2P (e.g.: bitcoin, torrents, etc.).. While I think that it would be wonderful to have a non-centralized platform where you can vote on stories/opinions, I understand that it is a ridiculously complex thing to try to implement, and I am not sure that any of the current implementations that have been created very much suffice yet.. One thing is certain in my mind though: the current voat site is a much better ship to be sailing than the sinking reddit ship..

・I really hated the "reddit gold" idea and system.. To me it just seemed like some clever (but evil) idea that reddit had to get more money.. The reason I don't like it is because, most people don't use any features that reddit-gold has to offer, yet you can't refuse receiving it, and have no idea who gave it to you.. Bob gives Alice some reddit-gold by giving real money to the reddit company. Alice doesn't really need any of its features, but she says "Thanks to whom ever gave me gold" any way. Alice can't possibly deny/refuse receiving the gold (for example so that Bob could give it to some one else that would actually use its features). Bob ends up thinking Alice really enjoyed receiving that gold. What actually ends up happening is Alice hardly uses any of those features, but the reddit company still ends up with Bob's money.. To me, it seems like a cleverly designed system to boost profits by having people buy things for other people that they don't really need. Same reason fruit-cake sales go up during christmas; Bob buys Alice fruit-cake for xmas, Alice says "Thanks", but ends up throwing it in the garbage-disposal.. The only real winner ends up being the fruit-cake company..

About voat: I like the stipulation where you have to receive 100 up-votes or some thing before you can begin to down-vote things.. I think if this site can keep implementing clever ideas like this, it should be able to curtail (a little at least) some malicious users from easily being able to wreak the site..

P.S.: It would be nice to have an option in the account settings to select which tab (Hot/New/Top) is selected by default when you go to a subverse.. It always defaults to "Hot", and I always change it to "Top" most of the time.. That doubles your page requests for every subverse I visit because I have to change it every time..

Why Reading and Writing on Paper Can be Better for Your Brain

All my notes -- world building, plotting, character concepts -- as well as my first draft are hand written in notebooks. It really helps me slow down and think through my ideas. It's also much easier to have a notebook on hand to write in between downtimes doing daily chores. I recommend it to everyone.

One major advantage is that when you're transcribing it to the computer you're already starting on your first edit pass. You're moving straight through and finding all those little plot holes easily. It really made subsequent edit passes much easier.
